bestBets.overview: IMAGE ARTIST resumes from spell. She took on some quality races at her first prep and was placed in the Listed Cinderella Stakes. Placed in recent trial and will to follow her fresh. FAVOURITE CHAIR was in the market at Balaklava on debut and he chased home strongly into minor placing. Better from the race experience and must consider. FARTOO FRISKY was $9 into $6 in town on debut but just battled. Expecting her to have taken benefit from that run. ANGRY BERDI comes off a strong trial win leading into this and would watch for any market support. GRECIAN JEWEL was placed in a 1000m Halidon trial last month.

raceTips.comment: Image Artist resumes and was big odds and well beaten at Flemington over 1400m on Apr 25. She was placed in the Listed Cinderella Stakes back in Feb and finished 2nd in a recent jump-out Favourite Chair ran well when 3rd behind Azytass at Balaklava over 1050m on Jul 26. Zeus Lightning is on debut for Michael Hickmott. He did enough in a Mindarie Halidon trial and won his most recent jump-out here over 600m. Fartoo Frisky can improve on debut behind Shivouac at Morphettville.Grecian Jewel was 3rd in a recent Mindarie Halidon trial.

OLIVIA MARIE resumes from a break. She started favourite when placed at Strathalbyn on debut. She has won a couple of trials in recent weeks. ON TIK comes into this ready third-up from spell. He has not been beaten all that far in two runs back and can sneak a place. ARAPINA is a debutante from the Cozamanis stable who has shown enough in trials.

Just Comet showed ability in her first campaign.

bestBets.overview: SUPER WONDER started favourite on debut at the Parks track but after showing speed weakened last 200m. Had a break since and if he can find the front and a soft lead, he may steal this. SPARTAN LASS has plenty of early pace and if he can find an early position and get some cover she will give a shake. SETTLE PETAL comes into this at peak fitness third-up from spell. Battled on well enough in both runs back and although drawn wide must consider. PAY DIRT has been going well at the jumpouts and should not be overlooked.

raceTips.comment: Super Wonder ran 4th on debut behind Chica Astuta at Morphettville on the Parks over 1000m on Feb 28 and looked sharp winning a recent Mindarie Halidon trial. Settle Petal was OK when beaten 5th behind Scootathewoota here over 1200m on Jul 22. She gets the blinkers. Zerealm debuts for Sarah Rutten and worked home in a Balaklava trial back in April and has a couple of jump-outs under her belt. Pretty Morsel has been placed at four of 10. Spartan Lass is a former WA galloper who has moved to SA with trainer Indianna Weinert.

bestBets.overview: TASSORO made good late ground when placed here last start. Finds a similar race and if he can get some cover and a touch of luck soon after straightening, he will give this a shake. A TIME TO KILL was good here two starts ago then failed to handle the heavy conditions last time. He's worth another chance. BRAZEN QUEEN chased home Scootathewoota here at her latest outing. She'll carry 54.5kg after Alysha Warren's claim. There were excuses for GOODLOOKIN' GURU last time, she's worth another chance. MANDARIN has not been faraway in the finish in recent outings.

raceTips.comment: Tassoro had the blinkers when  2nd behind Paganini here over 1400m on Jul 22. He draws a sticky gate but should go close. Goodlookin’ Guru was fav in that race but never travelled finishing 6th and can improve sharply. Brazen Queen ran well when  2nd behind Scootathewoota here over 1200m on Jul 22 at big odds. Yee Oh also ran OK when 6th in that race. Mandarin finished 5th behind Healthandhappiness at Balaklava over 1400m on Jul 15.

bestBets.overview: LAFONT may not have run out a strong 2294m on the heavy ground in town last start. Back to right distance range and a firmer surface will suit her. CONTRARY raced on the speed and proved too smart winning at Balaklava last start. Should roll forward again and this a nice race for her. LUDINA only just missed in a driving finish at Mildura last start. Her run the start prior here was good when ridden up close to the speed. SUIT OF WANDS has been mixing form but is capable of better. DURHAM and I AM RALPH are others that could be worth including.

raceTips.comment: Durham looked good coming off the speed to run down Navy Rok, who has won since, here over 1600m on Jul 17. I Am Ralph could be an improver up in trip he made ground behind Easy Beast here last time out. Contrary comes off a strong maiden win beating, Valued, Youbeeforty and Suit Of Wands, who gets blinkers. Heroic Rebel was OK at Strathalbyn last week

bestBets.overview: TOUR DE MOON resumes from a spell. He was placed fresh when last in work and was good in a recent jumpout. NOSTRYIA has been placed in three of his four starts this time in. This looks no harder and with Stubby Holder staying aboard he gets his chance to go one better. AZTEC DANCER has been charging home from the back in her races. Out to the 1000m looks ideal. COOL THE JETS started favourite at Donald last start and he finished too well winning from the back. Will give them a start but watch late.

raceTips.comment: Cool The Jets was well backed to win at Donald over 1006m on Jul 11. Magic Field has shown ability and went to Cranbourne first-up. Nostryia draws a gate and was good running 2nd behind Steel Tsunami here over 1100m on Jul 17. Tour De Moon won an Oakbank maiden last prep. Aztec Dancer ran well here when 4th behind Sioux Warrior here over 900m on Jul 7. The Magistrate can run well.

bestBets.overview: CAPTAIN JULIAN will strip fitter for two runs back from a spell and can improve out of sight on a firmer track. DARCI LANE has been kept fresh for this and is better than his latest effort suggests. DREAMS FULFILLED made some good late ground when placed here two starts back then went to town and was not disgraced. This race is no harder although it has been a while since he last tasted success. JUSTICA'S BONUS demolished a similar field to this over the 1200m here last start. Extra distance looks ideal and he can make it two on the trot.

raceTips.comment: Justica’s Binus was impressive coming off the speed to beat The Journo here over 1200m on Jul 22. He’s two from four here, gets in again well after the 4kg claim. TFashion Dog also comes through that race running 5th. Dreams Fulfilled is back in class after running 5th behind Fast Tempo at Morphettville on the Parks over 1400m on Jul 18. Play Bouzouki was a Donald winner on Jul 11 and gets in well after the claim. Darci Lane has ability.

bestBets.overview: BELLE FROM HELL charged home from the back and grabbed second spot at Strathalbyn last start. Will give then a start but she has a powerful finish and if they can make ground, will be thereabouts when it counts. TOES IN FIRST was in the market at Naracoorte last start but just battled last 200m. Happy to give him another chance. COLLATED is another that had support last start but did not come on. He has won on home track and this is not beyond him. GHAZNAVI battled on well enough when just out of the placings at Balaklava last start.

raceTips.comment: Belle From Hell made good ground from the back when 2nd behind Full Commitment at Strathalbyn over 1600m last week. Hallstatt ran well when 5th behind Fight For Freedom here over 1600m on Jul 7. Ghaznavi is racing well and finished 5th behind Je City at Balaklava last time over 1400m on Jul 26. Collated was OK when 7th behind Stolen Kiss here over 1600m on Jul 22. Take A Pick and Royal Fox are both back from city class.
